buggy.reindex_categorical_na_fill:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import xarray as xr

cat = pd.Categorical(
    ["foo", "bar", "baz"],
    categories=["foo", "bar", "baz", "qux", "quux", "corge"],
)
ds = xr.Dataset({"cat": ("index", cat)}, coords={"index": ("index", np.arange(3))})
expected = pd.array([pd.NA, "bar", "bar"], dtype=cat.dtype)

for tag, fill in (("nan", np.nan), ("pdna", pd.NA)):
    try:
        got = ds.reindex(index=[-1, 1, 1], fill_value=fill)["cat"].to_pandas().values
        try:
            ok = bool(got.equals(expected))
        except Exception as cmp_exc:
            print("COMPARE_FAILED", tag, repr(cmp_exc))
            ok = False
        probe("reindex_fillvalue_" + tag, 1.0 if ok else 0.0)
    except Exception as exc:
        print("REINDEX_RAISED", tag, type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
        probe("reindex_fillvalue_" + tag, -1.0)
